entries.migration_impact: Grok users must reinstall or update plate-core after this ships (`grok plugin install plate-core@plate-marketplace --trust` or `grok plugin update`) and reload the TUI. Bundled skills require the #577 payload (skills/ + SKILLS.md) in the installed copy.
entries.agent_notes: Grok runtime ignores flat .mcp.json server maps even though grok plugin validate passes. Official marketplace plugins (vercel, neon, mongodb) all wrap servers under mcpServers. Pair with --trust at install for stdio MCP execution.
migration_guidance: 1. Ensure pip install plate-core so plate-mcp is on PATH.
2. grok plugin install plate-core@plate-marketplace --trust (or reinstall from .plugin).
3. Enable plugin + reload TUI; run grok inspect and confirm plate-core (stdio) MCP and plugin: plate-core skills.
4. If an older marketplace install remains, uninstall duplicates and reinstall once.

entries.migration_impact: Baseline catalog edits must run `python3 scripts/generate-plugin-skills.py` before merge. Plugin manifests now declare `skills: skills/`. Grok marketplace index will list bundled skills after regenerating plugin-index.json.
entries.agent_notes: Never hand-edit `plugin/SKILLS.md`, `.plugin/SKILLS.md`, or `skills/*/SKILL.md`. Edit `src/plate_core/data/baseline_catalog.yml`, run the generator, commit outputs, and let CI enforce sync.
migration_guidance: 2. Run `python3 scripts/generate-plugin-skills.py` to refresh `plugin/` and `.plugin/` skill surfaces.
3. Run `python3 scripts/generate-grok-plugin-index.py` if marketplace previews should include the new skills.
4. Commit generated files; CI runs `generate-plugin-skills.py --check` on every PR.
